After 4 hours without power, move perishable food from the fridge into a cooler with ice. Never taste food to check it.
turns.say: How long does food stay safe without power?

turns.reply: Throw out perishable food (meat, fish, eggs, milk, leftovers, cut fruit and vegetables) that went more than 4 hours without power or a cold source, and anything with an unusual smell, color, or texture. Frozen food that still has ice crystals, or is at 40°F or below, can be refrozen or cooked. Never taste food to check it. When in doubt, throw it out.
